name: Poppy Redwood
source:
Poppy is the the older sibling of the protagonist in Timeless.

She is an athletic girl with a strong focus on mental and physical health. Frequently working out she is a runner for the school PE team and is also training to be an athlete when she is older. 

Poppy cares dearly for everybody she meets and will encourage them to do their best with everything, even if they don't neccesarily want to, she can come off as pushy or bossy, but she will always have pure intentions in her heart.
